title: Local ball-wise C^{1,alpha} bounds give C^{1,alpha} on compact subsets (covering argument)
statement: Let n be a natural number, E a real normed space, alpha > 0, U an open subset of R^n and F : R^n -> E. Assume every x in U has a radius R > 0 such that the open ball B_R(x) is contained in U, F is C^1 on B_R(x), and for some constant C, ||DF(y) - DF(z)|| <= C |y - z|^alpha for all y, z in B_R(x) (DF = fderiv). Then F is C^1 on U, and for every compact K contained in U there is C with ||D^1F(x) - D^1F(y)|| <= C |x - y|^alpha for all x, y in K, where D^1F = iteratedFDeriv R 1 F.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (α : ℝ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (F : Rn n → E), 0 < α → IsOpen U → (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ball x R ⊆ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F (ball x R) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ ball x R, ∀ z ∈ ball x R, ‖fderiv ℝ F y - fderiv ℝ F z‖ ≤ C * ‖y - z‖ ^ α) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 F x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 F y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
